Remediations.Description: With Game Pass, you can play more great games anytime.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game.

You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. 
You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.
The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.

BUT ESCAPE IS POSSIBLE

Lightning-Fast Gunplay & Flawless Movement

This isn’t just shooting - it’s pure velocity.
Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action. 
Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed.

Infinite Weapons. Infinite Possibilities 

Discover limitless weapon combinations using the ultimate gun-modding system. 
Strategically combine mods to create devastating loadouts. 
Unlock wild synergies that turn you into an unstoppable force.

Destruction is your Advantage.

Why just shoot your enemies when you can tear down the world around them? 
Environmental destruction isn't just for show - it's a core gameplay mechanic.
Blast through walls, collapse structures, and stagger enemies to survive.

New Run. New Choices. New Paths
Every run presents decisions. Which fights do you take?
Which paths push your limits?
Do you take the dangerous route for bigger rewards or play it safe? 
The choice is yours

A Passion Project by a Solo Developer
VOID/BREAKER is a solo project from developer Daniel Stubbington, known as Stubby Games.
Following his acclaimed Portal-inspired puzzle game, The Entropy Centre (2022), 
Daniel now pursues his passion for dynamic FPS gameplay and roguelites.

Features: Carve your way out through enviro destruction.
Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding.
Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI.
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
Hey everyone, Daniel here. The Ascension Update is live, and it’s massive. Here is what’s new:

Zone 05 & New Boss
Explore a new zone, face Ironclad and Voidout enemies, and fight VOIDWEAVER—a brand-new boss featuring an incredible track by Joe. Watch out for Voltaic variants that deploy kit-disabling EMPs.

New Sniper Rifle & Fire Modes
This one's been a long time coming - the sniper rifle arrives with 4 new chassis. Plus, every weapon now has tailored fire mode mods with buffed stats, massively increasing build diversity and allowing you to turn automatics into powerful single-fire rifles.

Community-Driven Changes
- Fragmented Zones: More added, including a new hidden schematic.
- Boss Pillars: Reworked. Boss attacks now release tetherable debris directly, keeping your focus on the fight. Visibility and responsiveness are also improved.
- New Anomaly: Storm.

Key Fixes & Improvements
- Expanded tutorials covering dash i-frames, staggering, and grenades.
- Improved wall-run detection, better firing responsiveness at low frame rates, and various optimisations.
- Enemy armour health reduced; mini-boss summons no longer drop farmable credits (sorry!)
- And more...

That's the June update. If you're already in - let me know what you think.

See you in the game,
Daniel
